findings.highlight: I heard about my father
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣がどんなマスターだったかも
findings.governingReading: I heard what kind of Master Kiritsugu had been
findings.explanation: The specific subject of Kiritsugu’s conduct as a Master is omitted.

findings.highlight: He also warned me about what I should do
findings.evidenceJa: 身の振り方も忠告された
findings.governingReading: he also advised me how to conduct myself from here
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s practical counsel becomes a warning.

findings.highlight: He recommended a lot of things to me
findings.evidenceJa: なんだかんだって世話やかれちまった
findings.governingReading: one way or another, he ended up looking after me
findings.explanation: Shirou’s surprised interpersonal assessment of Kotomine becomes a list of recommendations.

findings.highlight: Saber is bewildered
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは目を白黒させている
findings.governingReading: Saber’s eyes are darting or blinking in bewilderment
findings.explanation: The visible comic expression of Saber’s astonishment is omitted.

findings.highlight: You said you would call for me
findings.evidenceJa: 呼んでほしいとあれほど言った
findings.governingReading: I told you again and again to call for me
findings.explanation: Saber’s repeated instruction is changed into a promise supposedly made by Shirou.

findings.highlight: Your wound has not healed yet
findings.evidenceJa: 傷はまだ完治してはいない
findings.governingReading: your wound has not yet healed completely
findings.explanation: Partial recovery is flattened into no healing.

findings.highlight: Saber draws even closer
findings.evidenceJa: ずい、とセイバーはさらに詰め寄ってくる
findings.governingReading: Saber presses still closer with a forceful step
findings.explanation: The comic physical force of Saber’s advance is weakened.

findings.highlight: I am partly responsible for it
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜の傷は私にも責任がある
findings.governingReading: I too bear responsibility for last night’s wound
findings.explanation: Saber’s shared responsibility is diluted into partial responsibility.

findings.highlight: our contract to end
findings.evidenceJa: 契約を破棄する事
findings.governingReading: allow the contract to be nullified
findings.explanation: The explicit juridical idea of terminating the contract is generalized.

findings.highlight: She doesn’t look scary at all
findings.evidenceJa: 鬼気迫るというより
findings.governingReading: rather than looking possessed by a frightening intensity
findings.explanation: The narration’s comparison to demonic intensity is reversed into a denial that Saber looks frightening.

findings.highlight: Her hand stops
findings.evidenceJa: ぴたり、とセイバーの手が止まる
findings.governingReading: Saber’s hand stops dead
findings.explanation: The abruptness of Saber’s realization is lost.

findings.highlight: glares at me
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは一転して睨みつけてくる
findings.governingReading: Saber abruptly reverses course and glares at me
findings.explanation: The sharp comic reversal in Saber’s affect is omitted.

findings.highlight: Her protest is so entertaining
findings.evidenceJa: 抗議する顔すら新鮮で
findings.governingReading: even her protesting face feels fresh and new to me
findings.explanation: Shirou’s affectionate discovery of an unfamiliar side of Saber becomes entertainment at her expense.

findings.highlight: fortunate misunderstanding
findings.evidenceJa: 嬉しい誤算
findings.governingReading: a welcome miscalculation
findings.explanation: A pleasant surprise in Shirou’s expectations becomes a misunderstanding.

findings.highlight: or something like that
findings.evidenceJa: 俺も間抜けだったっていうか
findings.governingReading: or perhaps I was the fool
findings.explanation: Shirou’s admission that he misread Saber is omitted.

findings.highlight: Are you going to explain to me what it means?
findings.evidenceJa: 当然納得のいく説明をしてくれるのでしょうね
findings.governingReading: you will naturally give me a satisfactory explanation, will you not?
findings.explanation: Saber’s formal, pointed demand is weakened to a casual question.

findings.highlight: her real character appears
findings.evidenceJa: 地の感情が出てくる
findings.governingReading: her unguarded underlying feelings come out
findings.explanation: A glimpse of Saber’s spontaneous emotion becomes a revelation of her supposedly real personality.

findings.highlight: I can see that you’re a girl
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーがちゃんと女の子なんだって実感できて
findings.governingReading: I could truly feel that Saber is a girl after all
findings.explanation: Shirou’s emotional recognition becomes a visual observation.

findings.highlight: Saber jumps back
findings.evidenceJa: ざざ、と後ろに跳び退くセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber springs sharply backward with a rush
findings.explanation: The speed and distance of Saber’s startled retreat are weakened.

findings.highlight: We are here only to fight
findings.evidenceJa: 敵を討つだけの存在
findings.governingReading: beings that exist only to strike down the enemy
findings.explanation: Saber’s severe definition of a Servant’s purpose is softened and generalized.

findings.highlight: she tried to let me escape
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を逃がそうとしてくれた
findings.governingReading: she tried to get me away safely
findings.explanation: Saber’s active effort to save Shirou from Berserker is rendered as merely permitting escape.

findings.highlight: I have appropriate plans
findings.evidenceJa: 私にも考えがあります
findings.governingReading: I have measures of my own
findings.explanation: Saber’s veiled threat becomes oddly bureaucratic “appropriate plans.”

findings.highlight: I wanted to make the conscious choice to choose you
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の意志でセイバーの手を取りたかった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to take Saber’s hand by my own will from the beginning
findings.explanation: The concrete relational image of taking Saber’s hand disappears into redundant abstract choice.

findings.highlight: shakes my hand
findings.evidenceJa: 手のひらを重ねてくれた
findings.governingReading: places her palm over mine
findings.explanation: Saber’s still, deliberate joining of palms becomes a conventional handshake with invented motion.

findings.highlight: I feel her warmth through my hand
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の物ではない、彼女の確かな感触
findings.governingReading: the definite sensation of her, something not belonging to myself
findings.explanation: The tactile proof of Saber’s independent otherness is replaced by generic warmth.

findings.highlight: I will do my best to live up to that trust
findings.evidenceJa: その心に見合う力を振いましょう
findings.governingReading: I shall wield power commensurate with that trust or heart
findings.explanation: Saber’s pledge of concrete martial power is weakened to an effort statement.

findings.highlight: Her hand is warm
findings.evidenceJa: 握り返される感触が温かい
findings.governingReading: the sensation of her returning my grip is warm
findings.explanation: Saber’s reciprocal action is removed.

findings.highlight: my ally who will fight alongside me
findings.evidenceJa: 共に戦ってくれる“協力者”
findings.governingReading: a “partner” or “cooperator” who will fight beside me
findings.explanation: The deliberately modest, quoted relationship term becomes the more categorical “ally.”
